description: Who can open the app: each person's email, their name when known, their role (`owner` or `member`) and when they were added. For a part of a project with several, the people invited to the project, who can open every part, then anyone invited to that part alone (`project_id` says where each invitation is). Read-only: use it to tell the person who has access, and to find the exact address before remove_people. Without this tool, `npx uarpie people` does the same.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: people
